subject: RustGraph Summer Hackathon — community grant & trial extensions
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@rustgraph.org>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: events@rustgraph.org
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsorship request — RustGraph Summer Hackathon (community credits + prizes)

Hi Vanessa and Ben,

Hope you’re both well — I'm the community lead at RustGraph. We're running a three-week online hackathon (Aug 10–30) focusing on RustGraph extensions and integrations. We try to cover two needs: direct support for open-source maintainers who help mentor teams, and prizes / trial extensions for winners.

Would Redwood consider:
- a community grant of credits usable by maintainers (we expect ~8 maintainers to claim);
- 3 prize grants (each prize: Redwood trial access + $500 in cloud credits for winners);
- 5 developer trial extensions (6 months each) to offer to finalists.

Attached is our sponsorship form with event stats and past attendee data. If this sounds possible, could you flag what kind of paperwork you need? We can sign a short sponsor agreement or a simple MOU.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30-min call next week if that’s helpful.

Best,
Laura Chen
Community Lead | RustGraph Foundation
---

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the form.

Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in Partnerships:
- When you say "community grant of credits" — is that 1 pooled grant for maintainers to request, or a per-maintainer allocation?
- Do the winners need dedicated billing accounts or just trial tokens tied to developer accounts?
- Any requirement around data residency or egress for hosted trials?

Tentatively I think we can support a pool + trial extensions; I’ll run numbers with Ben and escalate to Marissa for sign-off. We’ll aim to come back with a concrete proposal (amounts and T&Cs) by next Friday.

Also cc'ing Ben to see if this fits our promo budget cadence. If you have a short one-pager on prize wording (what to call the Redwood prize) that helps.

—Vanessa
